steps: Note where water stains appear inside - the leak source is often higher up the roof.
For safety, most homeowners should not walk a sloped roof; hire a roofer.
A pro lifts surrounding shingles, replaces damaged ones, and reseals with roofing cement.
Ask them to check the underlayment and flashing near the leak, not just the shingle.
Get photos of the repair and ask about remaining shingle/roof lifespan.
